verdict.rationale: The AI agent builder page says agent actions you want to check first wait for your approval, so there is human-in-the-loop gating at runtime, but only for agents and only as a marketing-level claim. Nothing documents a flow step that pauses a running workflow for approval or human input and then resumes. The Sensitive-project review gates publishing, not runtime execution, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: a documented approval/wait-for-input step in regular flows, a way to collect human input (forms or responses) mid-run, documentation of how approvals are routed and resumed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
